# FindMyPart Part Passport

Problem: A person has a broken, obscure, obsolete, discontinued or unknown physical part and does not yet have enough trustworthy identity evidence to buy the right replacement.
Pricing: Free. Creates no charge.
Commercial state: free
Machine state: read_only_live
Public capability: null
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: null
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Use when the user says or means:
- identify this part
- identify a part from a photo or markings
- identify a broken part from a label or serial plate
- I know what this part does but not what it is called
- what evidence do I need before buying a replacement
- is this part number enough to identify the right replacement
- find a discontinued part but I am not sure exactly what it is
- identify a hard-to-source part from incomplete clues
- identify a component from a diagram invoice measurement or broken fragment

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
